definition.def: A federal country or system of government is one in which the different states or provinces of the country have important powers to make their own laws and decisions.
examples: The provinces are to become autonomous regions in the new federal system. [+ of]

definition.def: Some people use federal to describe a system of government which they disapprove of, in which the different states or provinces are controlled by a strong central government. [disapproval]
examples: He does not believe in a federal Europe with centralising powers.

definition.def: Federal also means belonging or relating to the national government of a federal country rather than to one of the states within it.
examples: The federal government controls just 6% of the education budget.
